in_english.name: Zarnish
in_english.meaning: Derived from Zaynib and nish, signifying spiritual beauty
in_english.long_meaning: The name Zarnish originates from Arabic roots, specifically from Zaynib, which refers to the wife of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), Zaynib bint Jahsh. The suffix 'nish' adds a connotation of spiritual and luminous beauty. Historically, the name Zaynib holds significance in Islamic tradition as a symbol of piety and nobility. In modern times, Zarnish is used across various Muslim cultures, reflecting a blend of traditional and contemporary values.
